critique: The note proves two existential obstructions: a non-Gaussian fixed-cardinality rank-boundary term invalidates a frozen covariance-only Gaussian coupling, and exact leading-risk ties can have nonvanishing ATE-coordinate distance. It does not determine the sharp modulus beyond the lower statement omega*(0)>0, establish any law for the selected estimator, or construct a computable uniformly valid interval. The transfer lemma assumes precisely the unavailable coupling and near-minimizer stability, while the proposed interval handle supplies neither resampling summands nor coverage. Because the refuted coupling was not asserted by Yang–Li–Wu–Yang and the load-bearing positive theory requires an unresolved fitted-score sublevel-set derivative and a new all-prefix analysis, the delivered result is a specialized warning rather than a field-tier inference contribution. The framing identifies these conclusions as open, so there is no stale prose over-claim.
